post.script: Socho, kya aapko lagta hai ki purani mamiyon ko hamesha bahut sambhalkar aur pavitra khazana mana jata tha? Hairaan kar dene wala sach toh yeh hai ki sadiyon tak Europe ke log inhe khate the. Madhyakaal se hi Misra ki pisi hui mamiyon ko dawa ki dukano par becha jata tha. Wahan ke vaidya kehte the ki insani mummy ka churn sirdard aur ghav theek kar sakta hai. Iski maang itni badh gayi ki bechne walon ne apradhiyon ke sukhe shavon se nakli mamiyan banana shuru kar diya. Lekin asli acharaj ki baat toh abhi baaki hai. Chitrakaron ne bhi mamiyon ko peeskar ek gehra rang banaya, jise Mummy Bhura kaha gaya. Europe ke kalakar unnees sau saath ke dashak tak apni tasveeron mein asli mummy ka istemaal karte rahe. Aur yeh ek aisa raaz hai, jiske baare mein koi baat nahi karta. Yakeen nahi hota na, par yeh sach hai.
